$comment: Structured conversations as data. The companion runs them with the RM today; an agent runs the same file later, one rung of the autonomy ladder at a time. Templates use {{placeholders}} filled from the client record; nothing else is invented. ILLUSTRATIVE.

autonomy.$levels: L0 drafts only · L1 approve to send · L2 informational messages sent, RM notified · L3 converses within a playbook · L4 voice

playbooks.name: KYC refresh
playbooks.goal: Confirm the client's identity, residence, source of wealth and objectives before the review date.
requiredDisclosures: Explain why the bank asks and how the information is used.
playbooks.doneCondition: All four confirmations recorded and documents requested.

steps.prompt: Explain the review and what it covers.
steps.template: {{name}}, your periodic review is due on {{kycReviewDue}}. I need to confirm a few details the regulator asks us to keep current; it takes about ten minutes.
Our records show you resident in {{residence}} with tax domicile {{taxDomicile}}. Is that still right?
We have your source of wealth recorded as: {{sourceOfWealth}}. Has anything changed?
Your stated objectives are: {{objectives}}, with a {{horizonYears}}-year horizon and a {{riskProfile}} profile. Does that still describe what you want from us?
Thank you. I will send a short list of the documents we need and confirm once the review is complete.

playbooks.name: Cash-need check-in
playbooks.goal: Confirm timing and amount of an upcoming cash need and agree how it will be funded.
requiredDisclosures: No new product is offered in this conversation.
playbooks.doneCondition: Timing and amount confirmed; funding route noted for the RM.

steps.prompt: Name the need and its date.
steps.template: {{name}}, I am calling about the {{nextNeedDescription}} you mentioned, which we have from {{nextNeedDate}} for {{nextNeedAmount}}.
Is the timing still {{nextNeedDate}}, and is {{nextNeedAmount}} still the figure?
Today your daily-liquid assets cover {{coverageRatio}} times the needs of the next twelve months. {{rmName}} will walk you through the funding options.
I will note this for {{rmName}} and confirm the plan with you before anything moves.

playbooks.name: Market update
playbooks.goal: Tell the client what a recent event did to their household, in plain words, without advice.
requiredDisclosures: This is information, not a recommendation.
playbooks.doneCondition: Event and exposure stated; RM follow-up offered.

steps.prompt: Name the event and the date.

steps.template: About {{topSignalExposedPct}} percent of your household is exposed to it, mainly through {{topSignalVia}}.
This is information rather than a recommendation. {{rmName}} is reviewing it and will call if there is something to discuss.

playbooks.name: Meeting scheduling
playbooks.goal: Agree a time for the annual review or a follow-up meeting.
playbooks.doneCondition: A date proposed and the client's preference recorded.

steps.prompt: Propose the meeting and two slots.
steps.template: {{name}}, {{rmName}} would like to schedule your review. Would {{slotA}} or {{slotB}} suit you, in {{bookingCentre}} or by call?
Thank you. I will confirm {{chosen}} in writing and send the agenda beforehand.
